verdict.rationale: HMRC holds taxpayers' personal and financial data, so whether that data can be kept out of AI-model training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack contains nothing on AI training, data-use opt-outs or privacy controls. The developer-hub robots.txt limits crawlers' access to HMRC's own API docs, which is unrelated to how user data is used, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
